storage_form: PROVISIONAL, same as devices.v0.json. See README.md.
extracted_from: kyu-softmatter/agentic-microscope @ e59e904, kb/systems/current.md (light_paths, optical_path_nis, confocal_scanner, light_path)
kept_fields_only: id, label, sources, detectors, required_selectors, excludes, automatable_gaps, grade. Spectral band tables, part numbers and the correction history were dropped: screening needs to know whether a path delivers light to a detector and what must be set for it, not which filter is in position 3.

consumers.s3_0: screens configurations; contracts/capabilities/microscope.json points at these ids
consumers.a4: checks that the plan's configuration is one of these and that its selectors are reachable
consumers.orchestrator: compiles required_selectors into a path lock; nothing acquires while it is held

one_table_rule: This list and the configuration list in contracts/capabilities/microscope.json are the same table (plan.md 4.6.7). Two tables drift, and the drift shows up as a plan that is valid on paper while no light reaches the detector.

configurations.label: widefield epi-fluorescence, inline source, patterned illumination available

required_selectors.camera_splitter: one of: single camera, or split

configurations.label: widefield epi-fluorescence, side-coupled source, no patterning

required_selectors.camera_splitter: one of: single camera, or split

configurations.label: spinning-disk confocal, laser excitation, filtered downstream of the disk
automatable_gaps: laser_combiner power, which is write-only and uncalibrated here

configurations.label: transmitted light (brightfield)

required_selectors.camera_splitter: one of: single camera, or split

configurations.note: the confocal dichroic sits in this path too, so there is no unfiltered white-light path on this instrument

configurations.label: optical trapping at 1064 nm

required_selectors.filter_turret_2: the near-infrared dichroic and its blocking emission filter
required_selectors.nosepiece: an objective that passes 1064 nm at the needed numerical aperture

configurations.note: the detection path is blocked at 1064 nm throughout, so trapping composes with an imaging configuration rather than replacing one: the trap light is invisible to the cameras.

exclusions.reason: the widefield paths are filtered by the cube in the first filter turret while the confocal path is filtered after the disk. The two schemes are built for different excitation bands and cannot both pass and block correctly in one exposure. It is the cube in the path, not an interlock, that forces this.

composable.reason: trap light is blocked from every detector, so trapping and imaging share the sample without sharing the detection path

gaps.what: the port position that actually carries the detection path
gaps.why_it_matters: any other value sends emission where no camera sees it, and a dark frame then has two possible causes
gaps.status: the prior project recorded one specific position as correct. The value is deliberately not copied: it is a single integer that would be wrong silently if the stand were re-cabled. Confirm it at the instrument and write it into envelope/ at M1.
empty on purpose. It needs the shared observable vocabulary (plan.md 11-1), which is a decision, not an extraction.

gaps.why_it_matters: axis A5 pays for turret rotation and disk spin-up in the time budget
gaps.status: not in the extracted dossier. Measure at M1.

gaps.what: spinning-disk in/out as a path selector
gaps.why_it_matters: with the disk out, the same hardware becomes a widefield path, which would be a separate configuration id
gaps.status: named by the operator, absent from the dossier. Not inferred here.
